Hi Ryan,

Your B30 and Power K. now ship on November 15, 2026, going to (address hidden). I'm sorry the date has moved again. It was October 30 when we last wrote, then November 7, and now it's the 15th. I know that's frustrating after waiting since July.

Your Power K. is already set aside at our warehouse. It's only waiting for the B30, and they'll go out together. The factory has been sending B30 units in rounds: one round left on November 4, and the rest are going out through mid-November. You can follow that shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

We emailed and texted you about the delay on September 15, and emailed again on November 3. If you didn't see those, please check your junk folder. Adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts will help the tracking email reach (email hidden) when your order ships.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Ryan,

I'm sorry. Twice this week you were promised an answer and didn't get one. That's on us, so here's where your order stands right now.

It's paid and hasn't shipped. Your Power K. is set aside at our warehouse in Tennessee. The B30 hasn't reached that warehouse yet, and the two will ship together to (address hidden) as soon as it arrives. Your order's ship date is November 15. But the B30 isn't on the shelf yet, so I won't tell you that date is certain.

I've asked the team to confirm the actual date for your B30. They'll pick it up Monday at 10am ET and reply to this email. Tracking comes to this address the moment it ships.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
